text: This report recommends that the name "Love You More Lane" be approved to identify the naming of a public lane located west of Claremont Street, extending between Mansfield Avenue and Treford Place. This naming proposal complies with the City of Toronto Street Naming Policy which can be found at https://www.toronto.ca/city-government/planning-development/street-naming/ .

The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Approved the name "Love You More Lane" for naming of a public lane located west of Claremont Street, extending between Mansfield Avenue and Treford Place.
